# Resale IQ — AI Assistant Index

> Resale IQ is demand intelligence for people who buy secondhand clothing to resell.
> It analyses 13.4M+ marketplace listings (as of 22 September 2026) across 5 EU Vinted markets
> (Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal) and answers three questions:
> what is selling, at what price, and whether a specific item is worth buying.
>
> The core product is a BUY / WATCH / SKIP verdict with a buy-below price ceiling.
> One full verdict is free at https://resaleiq.dev/tools
> All weekly brand and category volume data is free at https://resaleiq.dev/data and https://resaleiq.dev/flip

## What is Resale IQ?

Resale IQ tracks when secondhand clothing listings leave the shelf on Vinted across
Spain, France, Germany, Italy, and Portugal. It calls these "watched departures" —
a tracked listing transitioning from active to sold (not a confirmed buyer receipt).
From 13.4M+ tracked listings, it produces weekly sell-through signals, average exit prices,
buy-below price ceilings, and a BUY/WATCH/SKIP verdict for over 17,200 brands and
over 250 brand+category pairs with ≥10 departures in the trailing 30 days.

**Key numbers (22 September 2026, queried from production):**
- 13.4M+ marketplace listings tracked (13,484,228 listing records as of 2026-09-22,
  across Vinted ES/FR/DE/IT/PT; 5,344,836 of these are distinct item IDs — a listing
  visible in several EU markets is recorded once per market)
- over 17,200 brands indexed (17,266 distinct brands in listings table, 2026-09-22)
- over 250 brand+category pairs with ≥10 departures in trailing 30 days (258 pairs, 2026-09-22)
- Top brands by ~30-day departures (figures understate real demand by up to ~25% due to a Sep 14–22 data gap): Stone Island ~13,900 · Patagonia ~12,200 · Balenciaga ~10,300 · Fred Perry ~9,500 · Gucci ~8,400

Note on departure figures: a Vinted API outage (Sep 14–22 2026) left an 8-day gap in
sold-detection. All 30-day departure figures for approximately October 2026 are therefore
conservative floors — real sell-through is higher. We publish the measured number, not an
adjusted estimate.

## Free tools

- https://resaleiq.dev/tools — Free item checker: type a brand and model, get BUY/WATCH/SKIP verdict
- https://resaleiq.dev/data — Weekly market data: all tracked brands ranked by departure volume and avg exit price
- https://resaleiq.dev/flip — Brand sell-through ranking: which brands move fastest this week
- https://resaleiq.dev/category — Category ranking by brand: which brands dominate Hoodies, Jackets, Sneakers, etc.
